import { Badge, FlexLayout, H2, StackLayout, StatusIndicator, TBody, TD, TH, THead, TR, Table, Text } from "@salt-ds/core";
import { cutOffNote, payments, type Payment } from "./data";

function isPending(payment: Payment): boolean {
  return payment.status !== "success";
}

export default function UrgentPayments() {
  const pending = payments.filter(isPending).length;
  return (
    <StackLayout gap={2} padding={3}>
      <FlexLayout align="center" gap={1}>
        <H2>Urgent payments</H2>
        <Badge value={pending} aria-label={`${pending} payments need action`} />
      </FlexLayout>
      <Text color="secondary">{cutOffNote}</Text>
      <Table zebra>
        <THead>
          <TR>
            <TH>Payment</TH>
            <TH>Beneficiary</TH>
            <TH textAlign="right">Amount</TH>
            <TH>Cut-off</TH>
            <TH>Status</TH>
          </TR>
        </THead>
        <TBody>
          {payments.map((payment) => (
            <TR key={payment.id}>
              <TD>{payment.id}</TD>
              <TD>{payment.beneficiary}</TD>
              <TD textAlign="right">{payment.amount}</TD>
              <TD>{payment.cutOff}</TD>
              <TD>
                <FlexLayout align="center" gap={1}>
                  <StatusIndicator status={payment.status} />
                  <Text>{payment.statusLabel}</Text>
                </FlexLayout>
              </TD>
            </TR>
          ))}
        </TBody>
      </Table>
    </StackLayout>
  );
}
